[[File:Senatorialchambers.jpg|thumb|right|The Senatorial Chambers on Dayark.]]
The '''senatorial chambers''' was the main governmental building on [[Dayark]], and the meeting place of the [[Kathol Republic]]'s [[Kathol Republic Senatorial Council|Senatorial Council]]. The chambers featured a vast hall where the council met, covered by a large glass dome. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], the command crew of the ''[[FarStar]]'' was taken to the chambers to answer for the actions of the ''[[Lialic II|Lance of Endor]]'', thought at the time to be a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] ship.
